outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram illustrating exposure time vs illumination overhead as proportional bars, not a data plot of averaged measurements requiring individual points.
Panel B is a micrograph, not a plot.
Panel C is a micrograph, not a plot.
Panel D is a line plot (connected mean±s.e.m. values across two time points for each condition); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel E is a micrograph, not a plot.
Panel F is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve and shaded s.e.m.; individual data points (color-coded by cell, n=5) are shown overlaid on the curve, as stated in the caption.
Panel G is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve and shaded s.e.m.; individual data points (color-coded by cell, n=5) are shown overlaid on the curve.
Panel H is a scatter plot with a fitted mean curve and shaded s.e.m.; individual data points (color-coded by cell, n=5) are shown overlaid on the curve.
Panel I is a micrograph, not a plot.
Panel J is a line plot showing mean intensity with shaded s.e.m. across frame number; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
